description: Implementation of the AltSvcPayloadDecoder class for decoding ALTSVC payloads in HTTP/2, including state management and string decoding logic.

classes.name: AltSvcPayloadDecoder
classes.description: Decoder class for processing ALTSVC payloads in HTTP/2 frames, managing decoding state and invoking listener callbacks.

methods.name: StartDecodingPayload
methods.description: Initializes decoding of the payload, setting up state and verifying frame header.

methods.name: ResumeDecodingPayload
methods.description: Continues decoding payload based on current state, handling structure decoding and string processing.

methods.name: DecodeStrings
methods.description: Decodes the origin and value strings from the payload, invoking listener callbacks.
